title: The Future of Work
text:
Many people expect their careers to change a great deal over the next twenty years. Automation is already replacing some routine tasks in offices and factories. At the same time, new jobs in areas such as renewable energy and data analysis are growing quickly. As a result, workers will need to keep learning new skills throughout their lives.

Experts disagree about how fast these changes will happen. Some believe that most people will simply adapt, moving from one role to another. Others warn that workers without access to training could be left behind. For this reason, many governments are investing in programs that help adults retrain for new careers.

According to paragraph two, what are many governments investing in?
options: Programs that help adults retrain for new careers

questions.text: What can be inferred about workers who do not have access to training?
options: They may find it harder to keep their jobs
They will be paid more than other workers

questions.text: What is the writer's overall attitude toward the future of careers?
options: Confident that everyone will benefit equally
Pessimistic that most jobs will disappear
Realistic that continuous learning will be necessary
Uninterested in how jobs will change

paragraph_translations: Muitas pessoas esperam que suas carreiras mudem muito nos próximos vinte anos. A automação já está substituindo algumas tarefas rotineiras em escritórios e fábricas. Ao mesmo tempo, novos empregos em áreas como energia renovável e análise de dados estão crescendo rapidamente. Como resultado, os trabalhadores precisarão continuar aprendendo novas habilidades ao longo da vida.

Especialistas discordam sobre a rapidez com que essas mudanças vão acontecer. Alguns acreditam que a maioria das pessoas simplesmente se adaptará, passando de uma função para outra. Outros alertam que trabalhadores sem acesso a treinamento podem ficar para trás. Por essa razão, muitos governos estão investindo em programas que ajudam adultos a se requalificar para novas carreiras.
